title: Gig worker benefits platform
summary: Portable sick leave, insurance and super for freelancers and gig workers.
whyTempting: Millions of workers lack benefits and politicians talk about it.
whyItFails: Workers won't pay. Low-income users resist deductions. Platforms won't pay. Gig platforms avoid anything resembling employment. Regulatory uncertainty. Rules keep changing.
whatWouldChange: Legislation mandating portable benefits contributions from platforms.

attempts.outcome: Shut down after an acquisition fell through

attempts.notes: Health and retirement benefits for the self-employed; said it couldn't keep operating in the current market.

reasons.detail: Workers won't pay: Low-income users resist deductions.
Platforms won't pay: Gig platforms avoid anything resembling employment.
